comparison_basis.note: Controlled backfill; information after 2026-09-12 18:00 SGT is excluded.

thesis: 截至2026-09-12 18:00 SGT，9月12日的核心变化不是新的周末交易价格，而是Friday close之后实体能源供给约束进一步恶化：Saudi Arabia确认预防性关闭East-West pipeline，该线近期输送约400–500万桶/日；与此同时Hormuz通行受限，Bab el-Mandeb/Perim承压。周五Brent仍以$104.61结算、S&P 500反弹0.86%，这些价格尚未完整计入管道关闭；而8月CPI环比+0.4%、core +0.3%，市场已高度定价9月Fed加息。因此下一道可信裁决是周日/周一WTI/Brent重开后，UST 2Y与股指期货是否同步收紧。
dominant_narrative: 截至历史信息截止，9月12日最重要的变化是Friday risk-relief close对应的信息集被实体供给事件改写。周五S&P 500上涨0.86%、VIX降至15.88、Brent回落2.81%，但Saudi随后确认East-West pipeline预防性停运；同时Hormuz受限、Perim令Bab el-Mandeb承压，VLCC运费处于纪录高位。宏观端，8月CPI与Michigan通胀预期上升把Fed推向更鹰路径，2Y官方收益率收于4.63%。截至18:00 SGT没有可靠的管道恢复时间表，因此不能把Friday的油价回落和股市反弹当作风险解除；真正的跨资产确认必须等到油价重开后观察Brent/WTI、UST 2Y、USDJPY与股指期货。

top_catalysts.event: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West pipeline after drone attack, removing a 4–5 million bpd Hormuz bypass
top_catalysts.what_happened: Saudi Arabia confirmed a precautionary shutdown of the 1,200-km East-West pipeline after a drone attack traced to Iraqi territory; Reuters said recent throughput was roughly 4–5 million bpd.
top_catalysts.what_changed: A threatened bypass capacity loss became a realized routing constraint after Friday cash markets had closed.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Friday oil and equity prices did not fully incorporate a shutdown of a major Hormuz bypass route.
top_catalysts.transmission: Pipeline outage → higher crude/freight premium → inflation expectations → front-end yields → pressure on duration and cyclicals.
top_catalysts.confirmation: The line remains shut or no credible restart is confirmed while Gulf and Red Sea flows stay impaired.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Saudi restores meaningful East-West throughput and at least one major shipping route improves without new attacks.

top_catalysts.event: U.S. August CPI rises 0.4% m/m and pushes September Fed hike odds to roughly 86–90%
top_catalysts.what_happened: August U.S. CPI rose 0.4% m/m and 3.4% y/y; core CPI rose 0.3% m/m and 2.4% y/y, while gasoline rose 3.9% and rate markets strongly priced a September hike.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The CPI binary moved from pending data to a known inflation shock with a more hawkish front-end rate path.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Energy inflation is now interacting with firmer core inflation and higher household inflation expectations.
top_catalysts.transmission: CPI acceleration → higher Fed hike probability → higher 2Y/real yields → tighter dollar liquidity and valuation compression.
top_catalysts.confirmation: 2Y yields hold near Friday levels and September hike pricing remains elevated despite any crude pullback.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Fed pricing retreats materially because energy risk reverses or incoming data weakens enough to dominate inflation.

top_catalysts.event: Perim seizure and record VLCC freight rates turn Middle East shipping risk into a two-chokepoint cost shock
top_catalysts.what_happened: Perim at Bab el-Mandeb remained under Houthi control while Hormuz traffic was constrained; Gulf of Oman-to-China VLCC freight was near record levels around Worldscale 450.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The supply shock extended beyond Hormuz to a second maritime chokepoint while the Saudi land bypass was also shut.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Freight and insurance can lift delivered-energy costs even if benchmark crude temporarily retreats.
top_catalysts.transmission: Shipping stress + record freight → higher delivered energy costs → weaker real income → higher inflation expectations and tighter policy.
top_catalysts.confirmation: VLCC rates stay near records, Hormuz transit remains depressed and Perim continues to constrain Bab el-Mandeb.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Shipping security improves, tanker availability rises and freight rates fall materially.

top_catalysts.title: Top 3 Market Catalysts
top_catalysts.summary: Saudi pipeline closure, stronger U.S. inflation and two-chokepoint shipping stress jointly reinforce the energy-to-rates transmission chain.
paragraphs: Friday risk relief did not contain the full post-close physical supply information, so the weekend carried material repricing risk into the next futures session.

us_macro.title: U.S. Economic Data
us_macro.summary: August CPI reaccelerated while consumer sentiment weakened, increasing the chance that the energy shock feeds into broader inflation expectations.
paragraphs: Headline CPI rose 0.4% m/m and core rose 0.3% m/m; Michigan sentiment fell to 47.8 as inflation expectations increased.

central_banks.title: Global Central Banks
central_banks.summary: Fed tightening was heavily priced into the September meeting, while BOJ tightening expectations continued to support the yen.
paragraphs: Official 2Y Treasury yields closed at 4.63%, and the September 15–16 FOMC meeting became the next major policy decision point.

geopolitics.title: Major International Events
geopolitics.summary: Saudi land-route disruption, Hormuz constraints and Bab el-Mandeb/Perim stress created a three-route energy bottleneck into the weekend.
paragraphs: Reuters confirmed the East-West pipeline shutdown while Hormuz traffic and Bab el-Mandeb access were already under material stress.

regional_policy.title: China, Japan, Europe and Canada Policy
regional_policy.summary: China buffered domestic retail fuel pass-through while Japan, Europe and Canada remained exposed to tighter global energy and rate conditions.
paragraphs: China adjusted retail fuel prices on September 12, partially buffering the global energy shock rather than allowing full spot-price pass-through.

index_changes.title: MSCI / FTSE / S&P / Nasdaq Index Changes
index_changes.summary: No newly confirmed MSCI, FTSE, S&P or Nasdaq index change before the historical cutoff was large enough to alter the cross-asset thesis.
paragraphs: Friday index performance was driven mainly by macro, rates and energy risk; no unverified passive-flow story is inserted into this historical backfill.

flows.title: Pension / Month-End / Quarter-End Flows
flows.summary: No high-confidence pension, month-end or quarter-end mechanical flow estimate was strong enough to displace energy and rates as the binding drivers.
paragraphs: Mechanical-flow estimates are omitted where no reliable pre-cutoff source exists, preserving the report's no-invention rule.

etf.title: ETF Rebalance / Index Reconstruction
etf.summary: No confirmed ETF rebalance or index-reconstruction event before the cutoff changed the report's central cross-asset conclusions.
paragraphs: Weekend market closure prevents reliable ETF-flow inference from price action, so this section records only confirmed structural information.

options.title: Options Expiry
options.summary: VIX eased on Friday, but the Saudi pipeline closure was confirmed after the main cash close; no unverified dealer gamma narrative is used.
paragraphs: The report uses confirmed VIX and market data only and does not infer gamma flip, max pain or dealer positioning without a sourced contract.

treasury.title: U.S. Treasury Auctions
treasury.summary: No new coupon auction result displaced CPI-driven curve repricing; the front end remained the clearest policy-sensitive market signal.
paragraphs: Official Treasury levels were 2Y 4.63%, 5Y 4.78%, 10Y 4.96% and 30Y 5.35%, with front-end repricing most sensitive to CPI.

commodities.title: Oil / OPEC / Commodities
commodities.summary: Brent and WTI fell Friday but retained large weekly gains; the confirmed Saudi pipeline shutdown made the next futures reopen the key price discovery.
paragraphs: Friday Brent settled at $104.61 and WTI at $100.05; those settlements preceded the full Saudi shutdown confirmation and therefore carried gap risk.

financing.title: IPO / Financing / Capital Cycle
financing.summary: AI capital intensity remained investable but funding costs and negative free cash flow kept financing sustainability central to valuation.
paragraphs: Oracle's financing plan and still-negative free cash flow kept cost of capital relevant even as AI demand visibility remained strong.

breaking_news.title: Past 24H Major Breaking News
breaking_news.summary: Within the strict historical window, the Saudi shutdown, U.S. inflation data and Friday market close reset the weekend starting point.
paragraphs: The strict 24-hour historical window excludes September 13 repair estimates, Sunday attacks and Monday reopening outcomes from this edition.

market_impact.title: Integrated Market Impact
market_impact.summary: The next liquid confirmation must come from oil, front-end rates, FX and equity futures moving coherently after weekend supply news.
paragraphs: Confirmation order is Brent/WTI → UST 2Y → USDJPY/DXY → equity futures; simultaneous oil and 2Y strength would validate reinflation tightening.
